text:
Matt Boldy is the shooter on a Wild team that has turned into one of the league's hottest. He leads Minnesota with 91 shots, and his hat trick in Toronto on Nov. 12 powered a comeback for a seventh straight road win (Michael Russo, The Athletic). NDTV noted it was another hat trick against the Maple Leafs.

Here's the encouraging part for Minnesota: Boldy has 10 goals on 11.7 expected, so he's finishing below his chances, shooting 11% against a talent range centred near 14%. While Kaprizov runs hot, Boldy is the one with goals still owed. Our range has him around 41 by season's end.

He's been a two-way driver too. The Wild take 57.4% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, 7.6 points better than without him, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 70% of his exits leaving the zone with possession last season. What to watch: the shot volume. Seven shots against San Jose, five in Toronto. When he's shooting like that, the goals tend to follow.
headline: Boldy's goals are catching up to his shots
